newsitem.title: HUNGARY: BASKET DEALS DOMINATE HUNGARY FX FUTURES MARKET.
newsitem.headline: BASKET DEALS DOMINATE HUNGARY FX FUTURES MARKET.

text.p: Dollar/mark basket deals again dominated trade on Hungary's forex futures markets on Wednesday.
Modest turnover of 3.48 billion forints on the Budapest Commodity Exchange (BCE) was almost completely taken up by basket deals for December 1997 and March 1998.

Basket deals, by which dollars and marks are traded in the 30/70 proportion they represent in the central bank's currency basket against which the forint floats, are seen as a way of hedging against large dollar/mark fluctuations.
The December mark fell 0.25 forints to 114.60 while the dollar rose 0.34 to close at 199.60.
The more heavily traded March mark fell 0.05 forints to 118.65 while the March dollar was steady at 205.00.
The Budapest Stock Exchange (BSE) saw no trades.
